history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: Dhanbad has many Kali shrines (Ratanji Road, Shankar Colony, Khatal Road, Mator Kali temple, Sugiadih). This file documents the Kali Mandir at Hirapur/Hatia market, the best-documented generic 'Kali Mandir Dhanbad' referent: it is described by reviewers as one of Dhanbad's oldest and most popular Kali temples, sits inside Hatia market, is maintained by local Hatia merchants, and distributes mahabhog prasad on every Amavasya with large gatherings on Kali Puja. No source gives a founding date or builder, so no antiquity is asserted beyond 'old per local accounts'. Coordinates below are approximate (geocoder match to Hirapur, not a temple-site survey).

name: Kali Mandir
town_description: Dhanbad, in northern Jharkhand, is known as the 'Coal Capital of India' for the Jharia coalfields that drive its economy. It is a major industrial city and one of the region's most important railway junctions.

travel.road: Kalimandir Road, Hirapur/Hatia market area of Dhanbad

visitor_information.best_time: Kali Puja (Diwali) and Amavasya days; winter months
